Great Staff and great food!
Both Jessica's are awesome and so professional!
Great place to get in and out.
Bought some honey very good.
Thanks Deivi! We appreciate the great review.

The staff was helpful and knowledgeable. I purchased a 50# bag of dogfood. It was significantly less expensive than big box petstores or tractor supply and they gave me a free treat sample for my dog, as well as loaded my purchase in my truck. This will be where I purchase dog food going forward. I will recommend this to my friends, family and social media followers.
You can find everything for your farm animals, and they also sell poultry, rabbits, and ducks.

I really like this feed store. They have a great selection of products for all kinds of animals, and they’re always well-stocked. I mainly come here for my dogs’ food, and the staff is always friendly and helpful. I just wish they offered delivery, as that would make shopping here even more convenient. Overall, I’ve always had a great experience and definitely recommend this place!
Great place
I like buying dog food here. Quality food at a great price and always in stock!
I absolutely love this place my family has been coming here for generations. They are knowledgeable, friendly and prices are very reasonable
Has everything you need and knowledgeable staff.

My grandpa always used to purchase from this store and for more than 20+ years i've been getting my cattle supplies. They have good workers, very helpful  associates, and lets not forget the sweet lady in the back ... i highly recommend stopping by for all your feed and fertilizer needs !
Very great feed for cattle  swine and all your needs for animals, great customer service always

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. Looks like we missed the mark on your visit. We appreciate your feedback and are always looking for ways to improve. If there's anything we could have done better, we'd love to hear from you. We hope to have the opportunity to earn a 5-star review on your next visit.
Thanks Mindy! We appreciate the review.
Hi David - Thanks for the review. We very much appreciate it! We look forward to seeing you in the store.
It was a very nice experience seeing ranchers and cowboys getting supplies
Thank you, Sandra, for your 4-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you chose Hieden Feed. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

I love HIEDEN FEED!  Ive been shopping here for 34 years!   From all the staff to the incredible inventory... a one stop shop for animal feeds, pet food and supplies and all gardening needs.  Dont miss out on this iconic store that has been open for 73 years.  Love to visit with the staff and the owner everyone is so kind!!!...
Stop in you won't be disappointed.

I used to get my Pine Pellets here.
Was less than $8 for 40lbs but now more expensive than Walmart.

I don’t get my pellets here anymore because Walmart is cheaper for just as good or better quality and they are not sitting out in the weather all day every day, even if it’s raining.

Friendly & professional overall.  I recommend it.  Nothing that warrants anything above an average three star though.  I'm getting stricter with my ratings to help better distinguish between poor & exceptional businesses & locations.  There are better places out there.  There are worse places out there than Hieden Feed & Supply.  I do like that it's a family owned small business.  Try to support them as much as I can over big corporations.
Thank you for your review! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again soon!
Nice staff

What a total mess. I bought two bags of cottonseed meal fertilizer, but the loader at the store was completely clueless. He brought out two totally unmarked, untagged bags and swore it was the right stuff. I get home, open them up, and it’s actually crushed corn! Now I have to waste 40 minutes driving all the way back to fight for a refund because they can't manage their inventory. Unbelievable
Thank you, Rey, for your 4-star review! We really appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback and for supporting Hieden Feed. We hope to welcome you back again soon!
Mrs. Barbra is an ag teachers dream! She orders me what I need, my husbands program gets what they need, JV FFA loves hieden!
Thank you, Vanessa, for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are glad you chose Hieden Feed. Thanks for being part of our community!
Thanks, Christopher! We really appreciate the 5-star review. Thanks for supporting Hieden Feed—we're glad to have you as a customer!
Always friendly and helpful to the customers. Great place to get you local honey.
Real nice people
Great selection.
Good service
Great price on pine pellets and they'll bring the heavy bag to your car.

From the very beginning, the team here has been incredibly helpful with expert advice as we navigated our son broiler project. They consistently have exactly what we need in stock, which saves so much time. They do close a bit early, so be sure to check the clock before you head out. However, their top-tier service makes it well worth the trip. Last purchase until next show season.
Always friendly, products always in stock (or can get it), and great service.
My go to feed store!
Great price
Great rat poison
Best feed store on the north side
Very knowlegable, this is one of the best feed stores in the area.
Great value, service and knowledge.  Great place for livestock feed and accessories.

Super knowledgeable people, always very helpful. Great place to buy large cheap bags of hay for small animals. If you have guinea pigs or rabbits or anything little that eats hay you can save alot of money buying it here
Been going here for years and will not go anywhere else. The owner always helps me out and the workers are amazing
Great feed store, friendly staff.
They have excellent quality of service an also affordable food for all animals.

Hieden has a big variety of all types of items from livestock and horses accessories to domesticated animal shampoo and fungus liquids. And don't forget the seeds and garden stuff. Sometimes they have bunnies, chick's, rabbits and other birds for sale.
Last time I went I had questions on my daughter's livestock project and Kenneth was very helpful. He suggested that we try an item and turned out to work great.
Bought my husband a cap he loves it
Good people, great service. Super knowledgeable about (almost) everything they sale. What they dont know, they know how to find out.
Good
Prices on the feeds are a bit pricey!
Great store and always helpful for the first time FFA Mom
Went here to get roach spray. It was ok.
I abylove this place.
All things related to farming and feed stores

They are always friendly and helpful with my questions! They are always busy but they always run things smoothly! Not a bunch of standing around! They take your ticket and load you up very politely and you are on your way!

I liked it a lot because my daughter has been asking me for a bunny for a long time and I took her there and they recommended many things and how to take care of it and the advice we chose has been valid for 5 years.
I have come to this place many times for the past several years every time I come I have an excellent customer service the owners are really nice and they do care a lot about their customers
Affordable prices, great informative staff, and  convenient location.
I love this place, very professional and high quality food for all my needs
Staff was extremely helpful and showed us products we were looking for.
Very helpful
Great little mom and pop business
I love this store. Have all that you need and the workers are very helpful and great

Everyone is always friendly when I go and very helpful.

They have what other feed stores have. They have chick's & bunnies. They have a large selection of dog food in 50 lbs bags. Many different types of food for other types of animals that you would visit a feed store store for like chickens, goats, pigs, and such. After you pay for your feed stuffs you hand the ticket to their helpers to pull whatever you bought and then they will put it in the trunk of your vehicle for you. They do have good service, also they are very knowledgeable of different feeds
The people outside are very helpful with loading your purchases in your vehicle. They have nice garden plants.

A very interesting place, I really like the service, especially Cynthia; she's super friendly and provides great information about everything they have. It's a very family-friendly place, and I love it. I highly recommend it.

They have a large assortment of quality pet foods and pet supplies, plus poultry supplies and other supplies for larger livestock like horses and cattle. They sell medicine too. From time to time, they will be selling young chickens, ducks, geese, and rabbits. I've been doing business with Hieden Feed for over 12 years and have never been disappointed!
